case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70620.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
sup:70620.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your cost background. We value the long cooperation between our two family companies and want a fair solution for both sides.

Our own data shows a somewhat different picture on delivery:

Your on-time delivery was 85.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

With that in mind, we have prepared options built on a longer partnership. The longer contract term gives you planning security, and the options differ in payment timing so you can choose what suits you best.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.52; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.49; payment 14 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.

We hope one of these works for you and look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month contract and the option for 14-day payment terms. While we have reviewed the delivery data you provided, our pricing must primarily reflect the current cost environment. As to the delivery record data you cited, that does not change our position. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

As an alternative option, we can offer €4.87 per unit for the 24-month agreement with 14-day payment terms. This package is structured as a price of €4.87 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Logistics: We have free capacity for your parts. Our Lieferzeit is 7 days. With overtime we can deliver in 7 days, at a premium.

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your revised offer and for your openness. We understand that delivery performance does not change your pricing view, so we will leave that point here. We value the years of cooperation between our two family companies and want a fair solution for both sides.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.54; payment 14 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.62; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.

We hope one of these works as a basis for a lasting partnership.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

We acknowledge your revised offer and your desire for a fair solution. As your reliable partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and premium distributor service. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Due to our strict cost parameters, our current Angebot is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C.

To help close the gap, we propose €4.86 per unit for the 24-month agreement with 14-day payment terms. As an alternative, we can offer a price of €4.86 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Please note that this proposal remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful partnership.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your reply and for setting out your cost drivers so clearly. We value the years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies and want a fair solution for both sides.

We have moved again and hope you will see this as a serious effort to meet in the middle. The options let you choose between faster payment and a longer payment term:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.61; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.58; payment 14 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.66; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option B gives you the fastest payment, while Option C keeps the longer term you proposed. We would be glad to conclude on this basis.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

We acknowledge your revised offer and your continued interest in finding a fair solution. As our pricing is strictly tied to our current cost drivers, we have already reached the limit of our flexibility.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our current offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 90 days net, and a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

We value your business and hope these terms will allow us to continue working together successfully.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
